about: __make.at(seconds) moves along a part's plan, which is __make.cur.tl.T seconds long. Hash keys: s (shape), p (part), v (draw or make). ?look=0 for speed; drop it to check the look.

sets.name: plan
sets.note: One part from stock to finished, in tenths of its plan. Expect: metal only comes off, only where the tool has been, and only the cutting edge touches the work.
